metadata.description: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration

core_courses.description: Introduction to accounting concepts, principles, and the accounting cycle.
Continuation of accounting concepts with advanced topics in financial reporting.
Fundamentals of business management, organizational structures, and leadership.
Introduction to legal principles and business law applications.
Economic principles, supply and demand, and consumer behavior.
National and international economic systems, fiscal policy, and monetary policy.
Financial management, capital budgeting, and financial analysis.
Human behavior in organizations, motivation, and team dynamics.
Marketing strategy, consumer analysis, and promotional tactics.

electives.description: Investment analysis, portfolio management, and securities.
Strategic planning, competitive advantage, and business strategy.
Social media marketing, digital advertising, and e-commerce.

math_requirements.description: Functions, equations, inequalities, and polynomial operations.
Probability theory, random variables, distributions, and statistical inference.
